name: DOCS_RCVD_MEDS_3
description: This table stores medications received from outside sources.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the document record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: MED_FREQ_IS_PRN_YN
columns.description: Whether a medication frequency is "as needed". This data is currently populated only in ambient recording workflows.

columns.name: MED_FREQ_TIME_UNIT
columns.description: This item stores the time unit associated with a medication's frequency. This data is currently populated only in ambient recording workflows, where it should be a UCUM unit.

columns.name: MED_FREQ_TIME_QTY
columns.description: Time quantity for a medication frequency. For example, for a frequency of "twice per eight hours", this value would be 8. This data is currently populated only in ambient recording workflows.

columns.name: MED_FREQ_PER_INTER
columns.description: Number of times per interval for a medication frequency. For example, for a frequency of "twice per eight hours", this value would be 2. This data is currently populated only in ambient recording workflows.
